instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '气候相关机遇的财务影响'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业识别了哪些气候机遇类别（如低碳产品、可再生能源、绿色建筑、循环经济）？ 是否披露气候机遇相关资产价值或业务营收的绝对金额？ 是否披露该金额占总资产或总营收的百分比？ 财务数据对应的业务边界与统计口径是什么？ 金额与占比是否对应同一报告期？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅定性描述气候机遇而无财务数据；仅有减排目标或净零承诺；仅有绿色债券框架而无机遇收入/资产金额；仅有转型风险财务影响；区分：本指标关注气候机遇带来的资产/营收金额与占比；减排目标和净零承诺关注减排终点与路径，不能替代绿色业务财务量化披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In response to the China's 30-60 Decarbonization Goal (China strives to peak carbon dioxide emissions by 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060), we earnestly implement the national policy of energy conservation and emission reduction. In 2021, we formulated the Work Instructions for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction to standardize the management of energy conservation and emission reduction. [Content]
In response to the China's 30-60 Decarbonization Goal (China strives to peak carbon dioxide emissions by 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060), we earnestly implement the national policy of energy conservation and emission reduction. In 2021, we formulated the Work Instructions for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction to standardize the management of energy conservation and emission reduction. In daily operation, we advocate green office and save water, electricity and paper to reduce carbon emissions. Upon carbon emissions verification, performance and asset management for projects in Beijing, we registered an annual balance of 4,269.3 tons of carbon assets, contributing our share to carbon reduction.

About the Report / Message

[Content]
2021 marked the start of the 14th Five-Year Plan and the Second Centaury goal and bears great significance on Jinmao Services. This year, we were officially renamed "Jinmao Services" and our brand philosophy was also refreshed to embark on a new journey. In this year, we continued to improve our performance in environmental protection, employee care, partnership and community support to keep up with people's ever-growing needs for a better life. In 2022, Jinmao Services was listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Ltd. (SEHK) and released the first ESG report for sincere exchange with stakeholders to make future progress in sustainable development.
